lines.en: It moves slowly in the dark.
Voidborn moves slowly in the dark.

lines.zh: 黑里凝出来的，缟玛瑙做的针。
lines.en: Born of dark, with a needle of onyx.

lines.zh: 它没有脚，只贴着地移动
lines.en: It has no feet; it simply slides along the ground.
It sweeps the stone wall, leaving a scorch.

lines.zh: 它像黑水一样流下岩阶
lines.en: It pours down the rock steps like black water.
It curls into a lump like black stone.
Its outline slowly reshapes in the dark.
It draws its tendrils back inside.
It does not breathe and casts no shadow.
It presses to the floor and listens to your steps.

lines.zh: 它体内的虚空之心微亮
lines.en: The void heart inside it glows faintly.

lines.zh: 我盯着你火把照不到的边。
lines.en: I stare at the edge your torch cannot reach.

lines.zh: 虚诞发出低沉的嘶嘶声。
我的黑身上，绿眼只睁一只。
lines.en: On my black body, one green eye opens.

lines.zh: 虚诞的目光中满是怨念。
lines.en: Voidborn's gaze is full of malice.
My eyes glow green in the dark.

lines.zh: 虚诞的触手准备缠绕玩家。
lines.en: Its tentacles prepare to ensnare the player.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛中充满了怒火。
lines.en: Its eyes are filled with rage.

lines.zh: 它从黑暗中睁开一只眼
lines.en: It opens one eye out of the dark.

lines.zh: 它的目光让你忘了出口
lines.en: Its gaze makes you forget which way is out.

lines.zh: 它盯着火把，像盯着伤口
lines.en: It stares at your torch like a wound.

lines.zh: 它把脸贴到灯光的边缘
lines.en: It presses its face to the edge of your light.
It counts the echoes of your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在你身后睁开

lines.en: When it looks at you, the dark thickens.
Voidborn lets out a painful howl
Voidborn's call is filled with pain

lines.zh: 黑暗中扭曲的身影在诱惑你。
lines.en: A twisted form lures you in the darkness.

lines.zh: 你感觉到它在你耳边低语。

lines.en: I fix on the warmth in your hand.

lines.zh: 它的身形在阴影中扭曲。
你看到了它的虚空之心。

lines.en: It pierces the void with a needle.

lines.zh: 它的存在让你的灵魂颤抖。

lines.en: It beckons to you in darkness.

lines.zh: 针刺入你的皮肤，剧痛难忍。
lines.en: The needle pierces your skin, causing intense pain.
You collide with a cloud of black mist.

lines.zh: 黑暗中突然出现的针刺。
lines.en: Sudden needle pricks in the darkness.

lines.zh: 虚诞的针刺入你的心脏。
黑暗中的触感让你惊恐。
lines.en: The touch in the darkness terrifies you.
You collide with a Voidborn body.

lines.zh: 虚诞用针刺向你的喉咙。
它试图用针刺穿你的肉体。
lines.en: It tries to stab through your flesh.

lines.zh: 虚诞在黑暗中发出低吟。
lines.en: Voidborn emit low rumbles in the darkness.

lines.zh: 它的叫声如同深渊的回响。
lines.en: Its call echoes like the abyss.

lines.zh: 缟玛瑙针刺进来，我就来了。
lines.en: The onyx needle stung. Then I came.
Voidborn pierce the darkness with needles.

lines.zh: 它的声音如同幽灵般飘渺。
lines.en: Its voice is ghostly and ethereal.

lines.zh: 它在黑暗中寻找着同类。
lines.en: It seeks its kind in the darkness.

lines.zh: 虚诞在黑暗中呼唤同伴。
lines.en: Voidborn call out to their kind in the darkness.
It seeks共鸣 in the darkness.
My low call rolls along the stone walls.

lines.zh: 黑色的针扎入皮肤，痛苦！
我把你的掉落物拖进黑里。
lines.en: I drag your dropped things into the dark.

lines.zh: 这颗虚空之心，我捡起来了。
lines.en: I picked up this void heart.

lines.zh: 缟玛瑙针刺进手臂，我来了。
lines.en: Onyx needle in the arm, and I come.
Your heartbeat is loud in this cave.

lines.zh: 洞穴里的火光引我来了。
黑暗里长出来的东西，命运归我。
lines.en: Born of darkness, I decide fates.
You came down alone, exactly as it wanted.
I close in around your torch.
You cannot run fast in the dark.

lines.zh: 缟玛瑙针刺进我，我就出来了。
lines.en: The onyx needle pierced me, and out I came.

lines.zh: 我的针尖冲着你的脚踝。
lines.en: My needle points at your ankle.

lines.zh: 它把你的灯光一点点吞掉
lines.en: It swallows your lamplight bit by bit.

lines.zh: 它从三个方向同时靠近
lines.en: It closes in from three directions.
A tendril finds your ankle first.

lines.zh: 它只许你后退，不许转身
lines.en: It leaves you only backwards, never a turn.

lines.zh: 它用黑暗裹住你的耳朵
lines.en: It wraps the dark around your ears.

lines.zh: 黑暗中召唤我，虚诞诞生！
lines.en: Summon me in darkness, Voidborn arises!

lines.zh: 缟玛瑙针刺下，它应召而来
lines.en: The onyx needle bites, and it answers.

lines.zh: 幻觉最深时，它从墙里渗出
lines.en: At the deepest hallucination, it seeps from the wall.
The black water at the cave’s bottom turns over.
Your shadow gains a second outline.

lines.zh: 它从熄灯的黑暗里长出来
lines.en: It grows from the dark where your lamp went out.

lines.zh: 虚空之心在深处开始跳动
lines.en: A void heart begins beating deep below.
Voidborn falls from a great height
Voidborn is knocked back by the explosion
Voidborn falls to the ground, pierced by an arrow
Voidborn is hit by a spell
Voidborn lets out a despairing howl
